goal: Pip the puppy stands alone in the park on his four legs, seen from the side, so the child sees four legs.

Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. Pip: a small puppy with golden-brown fur, a cream chest, a cream muzzle, a cream stripe on the forehead, floppy ears with darker tips, large dark-brown eyes, a black nose, a fluffy tail, and a red collar with a small round gold tag. The picture: Pip the puppy stands on his four legs in the park, and he is the ONLY figure in the picture. A medium shot at a low camera height in the sunny park (picture 2). Pip stands on all four legs on the green grass in the middle of the picture, seen from the SIDE so that all four legs show (two near legs and two far legs, each with a round paw), with a happy face and an open mouth turned toward the camera. His whole body is in view, and the four legs are clear and separate, so a child can count them. NO PERSON IS IN THE PICTURE: there is no boy, no child, no Sam, no hand, and no arm. The big tree stands at the left, the pond is small and far at the back right, and the sun is high in the upper right. Exactly one puppy with exactly four legs, and no other animal and no other person. The page text is "I have four legs!" and is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. Exactly the characters named here are in the picture, and no other person or animal. Every named character has a clear, whole, friendly face. FOUR LEGS: draw four legs, two near legs and two far legs, each with a round paw, and keep them all clear of each other. PIP IS ALONE: no child and no pointing hand in the picture.
